title: Transformer Semantic Genetic Programming for d-dimensional Symbolic Regression Problems
abstract: arXiv:2511.09416v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Transformer Semantic Genetic Programming (TSGP) is a semantic search approach that uses a pre-trained transformer model as a variation operator to generate offspring programs with high semantic similarity to a given parent. Unlike other semantic GP approaches that rely on fixed syntactic transformations, TSGP aims to learn diverse structural variations that lead to solutions with similar semantics. We find that a single transformer model trained on millions of programs is able to generalize across symbolic regression problems of varying dimensions. Evaluated on 24 real-world and synthetic datasets, TSGP significantly outperforms standard GP, SLIM_GSGP, Deep Symbolic Regression, and Denoising Autoencoder GP, achieving an average rank of 1.58 across all benchmarks. Moreover, TSGP produces more compact solutions than SLIM_GSGP, despite its higher accuracy. In addition, the target semantic distance is able to effectively adjust the step

translated_title: 面向d维符号回归问题的Transformer语义遗传编程
translated_abstract: Transformer语义遗传编程（TSGP）是一种语义搜索方法，它使用预训练的Transformer模型作为变异算子，生成与给定父代程序具有高度语义相似性的子代程序。与其他依赖固定语法转换的语义遗传编程方法不同，TSGP旨在学习多样化的结构变化，从而产生具有相似语义的解。我们发现，一个在数百万程序上训练的单一Transformer模型能够泛化到不同维度的符号回归问题。在24个真实世界和合成数据集上的评估表明，TSGP显著优于标准遗传编程（GP）、SLIM_GSGP、深度符号回归和去噪自编码器遗传编程，在所有基准测试中取得了1.58的平均排名。此外，尽管TSGP具有更高的精度，但它生成的解比SLIM_GSGP更为紧凑。另外，目标语义距离能够有效调整步长（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: TSGP将预训练Transformer模型作为变异算子进行语义搜索，在24个数据集上显著超越标准GP、SLIM_GSGP和深度符号回归等方法，同时在保持更高精度的同时生成更紧凑的解。
en_tdlr: TSGP employs a pre-trained transformer model as a variation operator for semantic search, significantly outperforming standard GP, SLIM_GSGP, and Deep Symbolic Regression across 24 datasets while producing more compact solutions despite its higher accuracy.
